design_concept: Neo-Brutalist Soft (Archetype 3) - An approachable, high-energy Gen Z platform mixing soft pastels with sharp, high-contrast black borders and offset shadows.

headings.weight: font-black for massive impact, font-light for contrast
headings.anti_pattern: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings

colors.tinted_grey_rule: Never use pure #808080. Tint neutrals with warmth (orange/yellow) for this organic feel.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing: Use p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Leave breathing room. Dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 with gap-4.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Mobile-First. Never center-align by default; left-align dense content. Optical alignment is mandatory.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid background (usually white or pastel), sharp 1px or 2px black border to ground it, Neo-Brutalist shadow (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]).
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background (bg-background). NEVER use fully transparent. Sharp bottom border. Sticky top z-50.
surface_strategies.footers: Massive space (py-20 or py-32). Contrast Shift: Use dark footer (bg-foreground text-background) since body is light.

motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1, -translate-x-1) and increased shadow offset. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-primary hover:text-black).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties ONLY (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200). NEVER use transition-all.
motion.animations: Micro-interactions on buttons, entrance staggering for feed/dashboard elements.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text. Use APCA preferred.
accessibility.focus_states: Higher contrast. e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='exchange-request-button').

hero_image.description: Students collaborating in a university library.

community_images.description: Group of diverse classmates sitting at table sharing opinions.

textures_and_abstracts.description: Colorful 3D abstract geometric shapes create a vibrant and artistic design.

icons.usage: Use for UI actions, matching the 2px stroke width of the brutalist theme.

components.general: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural/marketing layouts. Use Shadcn UI for interactive logic (forms, dialogs, selects) but HEAVILY CUSTOMIZE to match the Neo-Brutalist look.
components.buttons: Sharp edges, thick borders, neo-brutalist shadow. e.g., `border-2 border-black bg-primary text-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-none transition-transform`
components.inputs: Solid background, 2px border, no rounded corners. Placeholder text should be muted.
components.charts: Recharts with custom pastel+black styling for dashboard statistics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON fully. Setup the Tailwind config with the provided colors. Install Cabinet Grotesk, Figtree, and iconoir-react. Override Shadcn defaults to match the Neo-Brutalist, high-contrast pastel aesthetic. Build out the User Auth, Dashboard, Search, Chat, and Exchange flows adhering strictly to the generous spacing and anti-default typography rules. DO NOT use TSX, stick to JS.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. For this project, use Neo-Brutalist solid shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully, but prefer solid tactile backgrounds for this specific theme.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
